key_concepts: High maintenance and development difficulty of early DBMS (e.g., IDS, IMS, CODASYL).
Resource economics of the era favored human labor over expensive hardware.
Existence of tight coupling between logical data structure and physical storage implementation.
Requirement for pre-defining all application queries prior to database deployment.

summary.title: Database System Architecture and Data Independence
summary.summary: The slide illustrates data independence in a DBMS through a tiered architecture diagram.
